short: Speech-latent target (M02) has a 2017 precedent and small, mixed single-run gains; spectrogram-loss-only end-to-end loses to WORLD (M06); a preference test replaces listener transcription (M12).
position: EMA2S [@chen2021ema2s] changes two components: a training-only spectral encoder whose embedding the EMA encoder must match (M02), and an end-to-end mapping voiced by a pretrained Parallel WaveGAN instead of WORLD (M06). Both are standard. The speech-latent target already existed in lip-to-speech [@akbari2018lip2audspec], and its increment over the mel-loss variant is 2.2% in MCD and 3.2% in CCR from single training runs (Table I, inference). With spectrogram loss only, the end-to-end system loses to the WORLD baseline on all four metrics; adding either the mel loss or the deep feature loss lifts PESQ, STOI and CCR past the baseline, and only the mel loss also lowers MCD below it (Table I). The evaluation (M12) is behind: the baseline paper scored listener transcription [@taguchi2018articulatory], while EMA2S reports a two-way preference test and an unnamed ASR on a same-speaker split.
